stages.headline: If D < 0 the trinomial has no roots and keeps the sign of a everywhere: the parabola lies wholly above Ox (a > 0) or below (a < 0).
stages.headlineEnglish: If D < 0 the trinomial has no roots and keeps the sign of a everywhere: the parabola lies wholly above Ox (a > 0) or below (a < 0).

stages.headline: Example: x² + x + 1 > 0: D = −3 < 0 and a > 0, so it holds for every x.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: x² + x + 1 > 0: D = −3 < 0 and a > 0, so it holds for every x.
